full_judgment:
This Rule at the instance of defendant-appellant-petitioner is directed against the judgment and decree dated 21-10-1996 passed by learned Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Bagerhat in Title Appeal No. 302 of 1992 affirming those dated 9-9-1992 passed by learned Additional Assistant Judge, First Court, Bagerhat in Title Suit No. 977 of 1990. 

 2. Sree Krishna Bain, since dead, as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 25 of 1988 in the Court of Assistant Judge, Chitalmari and on transfer in the court of Assistant Judge, Bagerhat the suit was renumbered as Title Suit No. 977 of 1990. Plaintiff instituted the aforesaid suit for declaration that the appointment letter dated 30-6-1986 made in favour of defendant Nos. 1-3 issued by defendant Nos. 5, 6 and 15 and the Managing Committee of the School constituted with defendant Nos. 5-15 and the inquiry report dated 28-4-1988 of defendant No. 18 are false, fabricated, ante-dated and also prayed for a decree of perpetual injunction restraining defendant Nos. 1-25 not to interfere with the plaintiff in performing his function as teacher of the School. 

 6. Learned Additional Assistant Judge, First Court, Bagerhat on consideration of the evidence on record both oral and documentary decreed the suit in favour of plaintiff by its judgment and decree dated 9-9-1992. 

 8. During pendency of the appeal the sole plaintiff-respondent No. 1. Sree Krishna Bain died on 6-5-1994. The appellate Court however on the application of the heirs of the plaintiff-respondent substituted the wife and one minor son and one minor daughter in place of plaintiff-respondent-Opposite Party No. 1. Learned Subordinate Judge upon hearing of the appeal by its judgment and decree dismissed the appeal affirming those of the trial Court by judgment and decree dated 21-10-1996. 

 9. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the impugned judgment and decree of the appellate Court below the defendant-appellant-petitioners invoked this Court's Civil Revisional Jurisdiction under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure and obtained the present Rule. 

 11. In the said case the plaintiff, a Chartered Accountant, brought the suit against the Institute of Chartered Accountants for a declaration that the agreement between him and the Articled Clerk was valid, a further declaration that the refusal of the dependency to register the deed of Articles was wrongful, still another declaration that the Articled Clerk should be registered and should be deemed to have been registered in the books of the defendant as from the date of the agreement. The suit succeeded and the declarations asked for by the plaintiff were given. In addition, there was an injunction restraining the defendant from disallowing the plaintiff to charge premium from the Articled Clerk", and there was also a decree for costs. The defendant preferred an appeal but, during the pendency of the appeal the plaintiff died. 

 In the result, the Rule is made absolute. The impugned judgment and decree dated 21-10-1996 passed in Title Appeal No. 302 of 1992 affirming those dated 9-9-1992 passed in Title Suit No. 977 of 1990 is hereby set aside. The order of stay passed by this court is hereby vacated.
